mentions.name: Banquish
mentions.description: This app lets users and AI agents assemble exact pieces from any websites onto a single screen. The embedded fragments are live and interactive (not screenshots), so they can be used like in a normal browser, avoiding the need to switch or refresh a bunch of tabs.
mentions.problem: Switching between and refreshing multiple browser tabs to see the website pieces you need.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on an app which you/agents can put exact pieces from any websites you need into a one screen.(https://banquish.space)
